name: Dwoemer of the Drill Faced Goddess
source:
"You received a dream of an artifact of great power, and have felt compelled to journey forth and find it. Your search has taken you to a mysterious cave, which will be the beginning of a strange journey into the depths of the world. Maybe other beings exist there, and few of them are friendly. Can you survive the trials ahead of you? And, will what you find be what you were looking for?"

This game was made for RETROMANIA, RMN's 10 Year Birthday Celebration.

[From [url=https://rpgmaker.net/games/9870/]RPGMaker.net[/url]]
translation:
“你梦到了一件拥有强大力量的神器，并感到有必要踏上旅程去寻找它。你的搜寻将你带到了一个神秘的洞穴，这将是一段进入世界深处的奇怪旅程的开始。也许那里还存在其他生物，但他们中很少有友好的。你能在面前的考验中生存下来吗？而且，你所找到的会是你所寻找的吗？”

该游戏是为RETROMANIA（RMN的10周年生日庆典）而制作的。

[来自[url=https://rpgmaker.net/games/9870/]RPGMaker.net[/url]]
